**成功发射，顺利入轨
Successfully launched and successfully entered orbit**

At 18:11 on January 20, 2025, China successfully launched four meteorological space remote sensing satellites, namely Cloud-Rover No. 1 37-40, using the Gu Shenxing-1 No. 16 carrier rocket at the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center. The satellites successfully entered their designated orbits, and the launch mission was a complete success. Among them, Cloud-Rover No. 37 is our exclusive "Weibo Member Number" satellite.
